overview: and houses Mercury, the ruler of Gemini and Virgo, holds a signicant role in the realm of knowledge, communication, and understanding. Mercury, the Messenger of the Gods, typically journeys through each zodiac sign for approximately 14 to 30 days. However, the exact duration can be inuenced by Mercury's retrograde periods. Around three times a year, Mercury appears to move backward in its orbit relative to Earth, creating a time of introspection and reection.
